notes:
The window watcher could go deaf and stay deaf. After four thousand protel windows in one run it stopped logging AND stopped reading lists, for as long as the helper was up — and the 07:00 reset could no longer reach it. Nothing was captured after that, with an empty watch log as the only sign.

The room panel now redraws when a captured list writes the ledger. It was only ever drawn when a department report was loaded, so a departure report opened in protel afterwards changed nothing on screen.

The live line says which list it is talking about — the newest capture now has the last word instead of whichever came last in the list — and what actually happened to the rows: how many were read, how many were usable, and how many were new, corrected or already known. "0 stays recorded" used to mean both a clean report the ledger already agreed with and a write that failed.

Rows that are dropped say why. "Holding-room rows ignored" was one count covering three different reasons, only one of which is a holding room.

DEBUG stops claiming the shift was quiet when it does not know that. The helper writes a line naming what it is watching, including when it is watching nothing.
